title: Ninety Seconds to Green
description:
Pager just went off. Marketing wants a scratch Guestbook stack **now**, and the YAML repo is offline.

You have the cluster, your namespace, and kubectl. Reach the end state below using **imperative** commands (`create`, `expose`, `label`, `scale`, …). Prefer flags over pasting a full manifest.

Reference: [Imperative commands](https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/kubectl/quick-reference/#creating-objects)

## End state (required)

| Resource | Spec |
| --- | --- |
| Deployment | name **`pop-up`**, **2** replicas, image contains **`nginx`**, **2/2** ready |
| Deployment labels | `app=guestbook`, `tier=popup` (on the Deployment object) |
| Service | name **`pop-up`**, type **ClusterIP** |
| Service ports | **port 80 → targetPort 80** |
| Endpoints | Service has at least one ready address |

**Meant for:** Imperative kubectl speed.

hints: kubectl label deployment pop-up app=guestbook tier=popup --overwrite
kubectl get deploy,svc,endpoints pop-up — wait for 2/2 and Endpoints.
Stay in your lab namespace (already the kubectl default).
problemStatement.brief: Imperatively create Deployment + ClusterIP Service pop-up (2 replicas, nginx, labels, port 80).
problemStatement.solution:
Imperative-only path (no full YAML file):

Docs: [Imperative commands](https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/kubectl/quick-reference/#creating-objects)

```bash
kubectl create deployment pop-up --image=nginx:1.25 --replicas=2
kubectl label deployment pop-up app=guestbook tier=popup --overwrite
kubectl expose deployment pop-up --name=pop-up --port=80 --target-port=80 --type=ClusterIP
kubectl rollout status deployment/pop-up
kubectl get deploy,svc,endpoints pop-up
```

Wait until the Deployment is **2/2** and the Service lists Endpoints, then **Submit**.
